summaries.Good news: Communities are showing up for each other in meaningful ways—from a Texas town buying a car for a woman who's fed thousands at Thanksgiving, to Texans farming for free to send kids to college. Real human kindness is creating ripples of hope and possibility.
summaries.Ideas: AI is becoming more introspective about how it thinks, while architects are being asked to lead conversations about planetary futures—suggesting that both technology and design are grappling with their role in a changing world.
summaries.Technology: From orbital data centers to AI-powered coding agents to breakthroughs in bionic hands that can feel sensation, technology is pushing into new frontiers while simultaneously offering tools to help us disconnect and be more intentional.
summaries.Design: Historic preservation and adaptive reuse are winning major awards, while emerging designers are creating boldly unconventional work—from spider-inspired furniture to brutalist-folk collections—proving that design thinking applies to everything from hospitals to museum garages.
